title: Tencent launches Hy4 flash to power high-speed, cost-efficient AI deployment for everyday workflows

quotes.text: Hy4 flash has 224 billion total parameters (including 64 billion Engram parameters) with only 12 billion active parameters
Hy4 flash achieved user satisfaction close to Claude Haiku 5.5
Hy4 flash is now available across Tencent Cloud TokenHub, WorkBuddy, Yuanbao, WeCom, QQ, ima, and Marvis
From now till November 30, users can access Hy4 flash for free on WorkBuddy, and get 50 percent off standard pricing
Tencent Hy also plans to open-source Hy4 flash with frequent iterations to continuously improve its practical utility

title: Tencent Hy4 flash cheaper AI model

quotes.text: Hy4 flash costs about US$0.070 per million input tokens and US$0.281 per million output tokens
In a blind test, 85 Tencent WorkBuddy users rated outputs across 259 tasks in 27 categories.
Both results come from company-run tests; independent comparisons aren’t available yet.
It accepts multimodal input and a context of up to 1M tokens.

title: Tencent Hy4 flash: 1M context model at 7 cents

quotes.text: The API costs roughly 7 cents per million input tokens and 28 cents for output.
Tencent built both WorkIndex and the blind test, with its own users and tasks of its own choosing.
The press release doesn't say in which countries the API is accessible or under what data terms.
As the brain of a coding agent it is not an obvious pick.

title: Tencent unveils Hy4 flash, the ultimate cost-effective model for everyday work

quotes.text: The launch follows Tencent's November 4 release of Hy4, which entered the top tier of open-source models.
